visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A toddler girl with her hair tied in two small buns wears a yellow sleeveless dress, standing on a light wood-colored floor in a hallway. (2) The toddler crosses her arms and nods, then suddenly turns and runs down the hallway holding a colorful toy stethoscope. (3) She enters a bright bedroom where a man is sleeping under a blanket on a platform bed; another young girl and boy are sitting on the bed watching. (4) The toddler climbs onto the bed and screams toward the sleeping man's ear while the woman filming follows her. (5) She runs back out through a study/office where the woman is seen working at a desk, then hides behind furniture. (6) The woman catches the toddler in the study; the toddler is held as the woman brings a medicine syringe filled with green liquid to her mouth. (7) Close-up of the toddler making a face as she swallows the medicine from the syringe, with the woman wiping her mouth with a tissue. (8) Final graphic screen with a pink background showing a cartoon character of the girl and branding text.
